storylines.beat: [39:26] Eight-hour debate marathon confirmed for weekend after next; Kendall's birthday week conflicts with this week.

lore_notes.fact: Claims birthday is actually July 10, not June 10; trolled Case about shared birthday.
Briefly regrew 'phantom hairs' but found it unsettling; prefers smooth scalp for consistent tan and moisturizing.
Uses regular table salt in baths (not bath salts) while listening to saxophonist Benny Joggins (not Kenny Loggins) and Pod Save America.
Has 'egg scallium condition' — bits of hard skin shed with mucusy membrane shortly after birth, like a prehensile tail.
Was at a deli near the Twin Towers on 9/11 but does not consider himself a survivor.
Household has eight bathrooms but all occupants cram into one rented portapotty outside; wishes they had bought it.
Ate spilled chemicals from bathroom floor; tasted good but would not stay down.
Plans eight-hour debate marathon for weekend after June 10; deferred How To segment to kitchen stream tomorrow.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell celebrates his birthday with a casual Hawaiian-shirt broadcast interrupted by Hype Train's gooning freestyle and a surprise Crash Bandicoot expert consultation. Crum crashes the party claiming a shared birthday (later revealed as a July 10 troll), co-hosts Amongst the Web reviewing web videos including a minion Jesus clip and Tasty's perfect combo masterclass, then endures a rapid-fire therapy session with Dr. Chath covering phantom hairs, egg scallium condition, 9/11 proximity, and Munch resurrection resentment. Pepito vomits bathroom chemicals at sign-off as Case transitions to Elden Ring for Shadow of the Erdtree prep, confirming an eight-hour debate marathon for the following weekend.
